changelog: First release: the game as-is from the local install
Launcher pipeline: base archive, version manifest, update system
Standard camera max: 20000, extended (C key) max: 40000
Enabled additional CTW heroes for regular Skirmish and LAN play.
Campaign-only variants and special heroes remain disabled.
Enable additional campaign heroes in Skirmish and multiplayer.
- Added hero abilities and their required unit, building and technology records.
- Added missing ability dependencies for Andromolek, Arri, Belisari, Battaglion, Carlini, Distruzio, Venza, Kakoolha and Yontash.
- Removed unavailable campaign-only spell chains from the multiplayer rules.
- Fixed the invalid Reincarnation graft chain.
